nodes.label: Cast the literal, never the column
nodes.rationale: acct = '12345' index-only 0.199 ms vs acct::bigint = 12345 seq scan 47.9 ms (241×). created::date = current_date 65.4 ms vs a range on the bare column 1.2 ms. The index stores the column, not the cast.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 42883 type mismatch
nodes.rationale: No text = integer operator. Treat 42883 as a type-mismatch bug, not an inconvenience to cast away. pg sends untyped text so a JS number against a text column still uses the index; hand-written :: on the column is the danger.

nodes.label: Implicit, assignment, and explicit casts
nodes.rationale: Implicit only where lossless (int + numeric). Assignment on store. Explicit ::, CAST, and type-named functions are equivalent. '42.7'::int is 22P02; 42.7::int rounds to 43. Invalid dates are 22008.
